sdl3.notes: SDL 3.4.16 for iOS 27 UIScene lifecycle (B11). SDL_image remains 3.2.4. Local patch (re-apply on bumps): src/video/cocoa/SDL_cocoakeyboard.m unmarkText returns early when nothing is being composed, so the macOS Pinyin IME no longer swallows backspace. src/video/uikit/SDL_uikitviewcontroller.m textFieldTextDidChange: sends the UITextField marked text as SDL_EVENT_TEXT_EDITING (caret and length in UTF-32 characters, like Cocoa) and an empty TEXT_EDITING when the composition ends, before any committed text; resetTextState clears it too (sendMarkedText, hasMarkedText). src/camera/SDL_camera.c: SDL_LockCameraUnlessShutdown (new; declared in src/camera/SDL_syscamera.h); SDL_CameraThreadIterate holds the device lock for the whole frame and marks a failure lost under it; DestroyCameraHashItem leaves the device struct and its lock allocated on backends with their own callback thread; ClosePhysicalCamera resets device->props to 0. src/camera/coremedia/SDL_camera_coremedia.m: captureOutput: takes device and hidden in one @synchronized section and checks hidden under the device lock; COREMEDIA_AcquireFrame skips a missing sample; COREMEDIA_CloseDevice clears delegate.device first; plus the frame-rate and zoom patches in docs/COREMEDIA_CAMERA.md. src/camera/android/SDL_camera_android.c: onImageAvailable (reader check), onDisconnected and onError lock with SDL_LockCameraUnlessShutdown. Re-apply all of these when bumping SDL; see docs/COREMEDIA_CAMERA.md.
